package com.mukasanches.zapptv.data

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.util.Locale

object ChannelResolver {
    fun canonicalId(name: String): String? {
        val value = normalize(name)
        return when {
            value.contains("tv camara") || value == "camara" -> "BR_TV_CAMARA"
            value.contains("tv senado") || value == "senado" -> "BR_TV_SENADO"
            value.contains("tv brasil internacional") -> "BR_TV_BRASIL_INT"
            value == "tv brasil" || value.startsWith("tv brasil ") -> "BR_TV_BRASIL"
            value.contains("tv cultura") || value == "cultura" -> "BR_TV_CULTURA"
            value.contains("globo") -> "BR_GLOBO"
            value.contains("sbt") -> "BR_SBT"
            value.contains("record news") -> "BR_RECORD_NEWS"
            value.contains("record") -> "BR_RECORD"
            value.contains("band") -> "BR_BAND"
            value.contains("redetv") || value.contains("rede tv") -> "BR_REDETV"
            else -> null
        }
    }

    fun normalize(value: String): String {
        val noAccent = Normalizer.normalize(value, Normalizer.Form.NFD)
            .replace(Regex("\\p{Mn}+"), "")
        return noAccent
            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9]+"), " ")
            .trim()
    }
}

package com.mukasanches.zapptv.data

import com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.Channel

object ChannelClassifier {
    val primaryCategories = listOf(
        "Brasil",
        "Notícias",
        "Esportes",
        "Filmes",
        "Séries",
        "Infantil",
        "Música",
        "Documentários",
        "Lifestyle",
        "Público",
        "Entretenimento",
        "Outros"
    )

    fun category(channel: Channel): String {
        val value = ChannelResolver.normalize("${channel.category} ${channel.name}")
        val source = ChannelResolver.normalize(channel.sourceName)

        if (
            channel.epgId?.substringBefore('@')?.endsWith(".br", ignoreCase = true) == true ||
            source.contains("brasil")
        ) {
            return when {
                hasAny(value, "news", "notic", "jornal") -> "Notícias"
                hasAny(value, "sport", "esporte", "futebol") -> "Esportes"
                hasAny(value, "movie", "filme", "cinema") -> "Filmes"
                hasAny(value, "series", "serie", "novela") -> "Séries"
                hasAny(value, "kids", "infantil", "animation", "animacao") -> "Infantil"
                hasAny(value, "music", "musica") -> "Música"
                else -> "Brasil"
            }
        }

        return when {
            hasAny(value, "news", "notic", "jornal", "weather") -> "Notícias"
            hasAny(value, "sport", "esporte", "football", "soccer", "futebol") -> "Esportes"
            hasAny(value, "movie", "movies", "film", "filme", "cinema") -> "Filmes"
            hasAny(value, "series", "serie", "drama", "novela", "classic") -> "Séries"
            hasAny(value, "kids", "infantil", "animation", "animacao", "family") -> "Infantil"
            hasAny(value, "music", "musica", "radio") -> "Música"
            hasAny(value, "documentary", "documentario", "education", "science", "nature") -> "Documentários"
            hasAny(value, "lifestyle", "food", "travel", "relax", "shop") -> "Lifestyle"
            hasAny(value, "public", "government", "legislative") -> "Público"
            hasAny(value, "entertainment", "general", "comedy") -> "Entretenimento"
            else -> "Outros"
        }
    }

    fun isBrazil(channel: Channel): Boolean =
        channel.epgId?.substringBefore('@')?.endsWith(".br", ignoreCase = true) == true ||
            ChannelResolver.normalize(channel.sourceName).contains("brasil")

    private fun hasAny(value: String, vararg tokens: String): Boolean =
        tokens.any { value.contains(it) }
}
